name: Minakami Satsuki
source:
She is the younger sister of Hazuki, a priestess of the Minakami family. She helps her older sister Hazuki, who has been chosen to be the “guardian of Yaorozu no Iwato".

She is an honest, cheerful, and optimistic person. Because she is too innocent, she is good-natured and easily deceived. She is a virgin.

She is proud of her older sister, Hazuki, and adores her very much. She sometimes cries because she can't stand the abuse of Kurouto.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/shimaimiko/index.html]official site[/url]]
